name: D2SubjectExists
title: DHIS2 subject exists
description: Whether the tracked entity a registration response is subject to is already held by the DHIS2 instance. True means the subject identifier names a person the instance already stores, and the response enrols that person rather than creating one - so it is imported as an enrollment alone, with no tracked entity beside it. Absent or false means the response creates the person it names, which is what a registration does by default.
